items.title: 6.2.6 Tangents from a Point to a Circle (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 178-180: 6.2.6 Theorem 2 with Proof; Example 12 (chord of contact), Example 13 (pair of tangents from (5, 0)), Example 14 (tangents from (4, -1), points of contact)

blocks.text: Ab tak hum ne circle ke kisi point par tangent banaya. Ab ulta sawal: circle ke bahar ek point hai, us se circle par kitne tangents kheenche ja sakte hain aur un ki equations kya hain? Ghar par ek gol plate aur do scale le kar dekhiye: bahar ke kisi point se plate ko do taraf se chhoo sakte hain. Plate ke kinare par khare hon to sirf ek scale chhooega, aur plate ke andar se koi scale kinare ko "chhoo kar" nahin guzar sakta. Yahi baat Theorem 2 kehta hai.

Theorem 2: Circle par kisi bhi point \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\) se do tangents kheenche ja sakte hain. Yeh tangents real aur distinct (alag alag), coincident (ek doosre par chadhe hue, yani ek), ya imaginary (haqeeqat mein mojood nahin) hote hain, is hisaab se ke point circle ke bahar, circle par, ya andar ho.

items: Real and distinct if \(D > 0 \Rightarrow x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} > a^{2}\) (point lies outside the circle)
Real and coincident if \(D = 0 \Rightarrow x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} = a^{2}\) (point lies on the circle)
Imaginary if \(D < 0 \Rightarrow x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} < a^{2}\) (point lies inside the circle).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Proof ka asal idea: slope \(m\) wala har tangent \(y = mx \pm a\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}\) hai. Jo tangent \(P\) se guzre woh inhi mein se koi hoga. To sawal yeh bana: kis \(m\) ke liye yeh line \(P\) se guzarti hai? Jawab \(m\) ki ek quadratic equation hai, is liye zyada se zyada do slopes, yani do tangents.
\(D\) ka sign wahi hai jo \(x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} - a^{2}\) ka, aur yahi Theorem 1 wala test hai! Bahar: do real tangents; circle par: ek (dono mil gaye); andar: koi nahin.
Square karne se \(\pm a\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}\) dono signs shamil ho jate hain, is liye \(P\) se guzarne wala koi tangent chhoot ta nahin.
Khaas case: agar \(x_{1}^{2} = a^{2}\) ho (maslan \(P(3, 5)\) aur \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 9\)), to \(m^{2}\) wala term ghayab ho jata hai aur sirf ek slope milta hai. Doosra tangent vertical line \(x = x_{1}\) hai, jis ka slope hota hi nahin. Exam mein yeh doosra tangent likhna mat bhooliye.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Neeche ki teen misalon mein bahar ke point se tangents ke teen alag tareeqe hain: Example 12 (chord of contact, points nikale baghair), Example 13 (tangents par aam point \((h, k)\) le kar ek combined equation) aur Example 14 (na-maloom slope \(m\), centre se faasla = radius). Teeno ko dhyan se dekhiye; exam mein sawal ki shakal dekh kar tareeqa chunna hota hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal kitab ki nahin; is mein woh khaas case hai jahan ek tangent vertical hota hai. Point \((3, 5)\) se circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 9\) par tangents nikaliye.
Pehle test: \(9 + 25 - 9 = 25 > 0\), point bahar hai, to do tangents hone chahiye.
Slope \(m\) wali line \(y - 5 = m(x - 3)\), yani \(mx - y + 5 - 3m = 0\). Centre se faasla = radius:
\[\dfrac{|5 - 3m|}{\sqrt{m^{2} + 1}} = 3\]
\[25 - 30m + 9m^{2} = 9m^{2} + 9\]
\(m^{2}\) cancel ho gaya! Sirf ek value bachi: \(m = \frac{16}{30} = \frac{8}{15}\). Tangent: \(8x - 15y + 51 = 0\) (faasla \(\frac{51}{17} = 3\), theek).
Doosra tangent kahan gaya? Woh vertical line \(x = 3\) hai, jis ka slope hota hi nahin, is liye \(m\) wali equation use pakar nahin saki. \(x = 3\) ka origin se faasla 3 hai, yani yeh bhi tangent hai. Sabaq: jab \(x_{1}^{2} = a^{2}\) ho to vertical tangent khud se likhiye.

Ab pehli kitabi misaal. Is mein ek nayi cheez ka naam aata hai: chord of contact. Bahar ke point se do tangents kheenchiye; woh circle ko do points par chhoote hain. In do points ko milane wali line (chord) ko chord of contact kehte hain. Mazay ki baat yeh hai ke is line ki equation points nikale baghair mil jati hai.

blocks.title: Example 12
blocks.problem: Tangents are drawn from \((4, 5)\) to the circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 29\). Find an equation of the line joining the points of contact (The line is called the chord of contact).
steps:
Diya gaya: point \((4, 5)\) aur circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 29\).
Maloom karna: chord of contact ki equation, yani us line ki jo dono points of contact ko milati hai.
Tareeqa: humein points of contact khud nikalne ki zaroorat hi nahin! Har (na-maloom) point of contact par tangent likhenge, phir yeh baat istemal karenge ke dono tangents \((4, 5)\) se guzarte hain. Us ke baad dekhenge ke dono points ek hi linear equation ko poora karte hain. Yeh is sawal ki khoobsurat chaal hai.

Qadam 1: Kya \((4, 5)\) circle ke bahar hai?
\[4^{2} + 5^{2} - 29 = 16 + 25 - 29 = 12 > 0\]
Kyun: Theorem 1 aur Theorem 2 ke mutabiq real aur alag tangents sirf bahar ke point se kheenche ja sakte hain. Positive aaya, yani point bahar hai; sawal theek hai.

Qadam 2: Points of contact par tangents
Maan lijiye dono tangents ke points of contact \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\) aur \(Q(x_{2}, y_{2})\) hain.
\(P\) par tangent \(xx_{1} + yy_{1} = 29\) aur \(Q\) par tangent \(xx_{2} + yy_{2} = 29\) hai.
Kyun: \(x^{2} + y^{2} = r^{2}\) ke point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent \(xx_{1} + yy_{1} = r^{2}\) hota hai (6.2.1).

Qadam 3: Dono tangents \((4, 5)\) se guzarte hain
\[4x_{1} + 5y_{1} = 29\]
\[4x_{2} + 5y_{2} = 29\]
Kyun: har tangent mein \(x = 4\), \(y = 5\) rakh diye, kyun ke \((4, 5)\) dono lines par hai.

Qadam 4: Chord of contact pehchanna
Ab ghor kijiye: \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\) aur \(Q(x_{2}, y_{2})\) dono equation
\[4x + 5y = 29\]
ko poora karte hain. Is liye chord of contact ki equation \(4x + 5y = 29\) hai.
Kyun: \(4x + 5y = 29\) ek seedhi line hai aur dono points of contact us par hain. Do points se sirf ek hi line guzar sakti hai, is liye yahi line \(PQ\) hai.
Dhyan dein: yeh line bilkul 6.2.2 ke rule jaisi shakal rakhti hai (\(xx_{1} + yy_{1} = 29\) mein \((4, 5)\) rakh diya), magar \((4, 5)\) circle par nahin, is liye yeh tangent nahin balke chord of contact hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(4x + 5y = 29\) aur \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 29\) ko saath hal karne se do points milte hain: \(\left(\frac{116 \pm 10\sqrt{87}}{41}, \frac{145 \mp 8\sqrt{87}}{41}\right)\). In points par tangents dono \((4, 5)\) se guzarte hain (sympy se tasdeeq ki).
Centre se \((4, 5)\) tak line ka slope \(\frac{5}{4}\) aur chord ka slope \(-\frac{4}{5}\) hai: product \(-1\). Yani chord of contact centre aur bahar wale point ko milane wali line par perpendicular hai, jaisa figure ki symmetry (do taraf barabari) se hona chahiye.
blocks.answer: Chord of contact ki equation \(4x + 5y = 29\) hai.

blocks.text: Doosri misaal mein humein dono tangents alag alag nahin, balke ek hi equation mein chahiye. Aisi equation jo do lines ko ikattha zahir kare, "combined equation" ya "pair of lines" kehlati hai. Is ka tareeqa yeh hai ke hum tangent par ek aam point le kar us ki shart likhte hain; woh shart dono tangents ke liye ek jaisi hoti hai, is liye dono lines ek hi equation mein aa jati hain.

blocks.title: Example 13
blocks.problem: Find a combined equation of the pair of tangents drawn from \((5, 0)\) to the circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 9\).
steps:
Diya gaya: point \(A(5, 0)\) aur circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 9\) (centre \((0, 0)\), radius 3).
Maloom karna: aik hi equation jo dono tangents ko ikattha zahir kare (combined equation).
Tareeqa: kisi bhi tangent par ek aam point \(P(h, k)\) lijiye. Line \(AP\) tangent hai, is liye centre se us ka faasla radius ke barabar hoga. Is shart se \(h\) aur \(k\) ka jo rishta niklega, wahi matlooba equation hai. Yahan "aam point" ka matlab hai koi bhi point, khaas nahin; is liye jo rishta nikle woh har point par sahi hoga.

Qadam 1: Line \(AP\) ki equation
\[y - 0 = \dfrac{k - 0}{h - 5}(x - 5)\]
\[\Rightarrow y = \dfrac{k}{h - 5}(x - 5)\]
\[\Rightarrow y(h - 5) = k(x - 5)\]
\[\Rightarrow kx - (h - 5)y - 5k = 0\]
Kyun: \(A(5, 0)\) aur \(P(h, k)\) se two-point form lagaya; aakhri line general form hai, jo distance formula ke liye tayyar hai.

Qadam 2: Tangency ki shart
Yeh line circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 9\) ka tangent hai. Is liye centre \((0, 0)\) se line ka perpendicular faasla radius 3 ke barabar hoga:
\[\dfrac{|5k|}{\sqrt{k^{2} + (h - 5)^{2}}} = 3\]
Kyun: \((0, 0)\) se line \(Ax + By + C = 0\) ka faasla \(\frac{|C|}{\sqrt{A^{2} + B^{2}}}\) hota hai; yahan \(A = k\), \(B = -(h - 5)\), \(C = -5k\). Yahi 6.2.5 wali baat hai: tangent ka matlab, faasla = radius.

Qadam 3: Square kar ke saada karna
\[25k^{2} = 9[k^{2} + (h - 5)^{2}]\]
\[\Rightarrow 25k^{2} = 9k^{2} + 9(h - 5)^{2}\]
\[9(h - 5)^{2} - 16k^{2} = 0\]
Kyun: square karne se modulus aur square root dono khatam; phir \(k^{2}\) wale terms ikatthe kiye (\(25k^{2} - 9k^{2} = 16k^{2}\)).

Qadam 4: \((h, k)\) ki jagah \((x, y)\)
Kyun ke \((h, k)\) dono tangents ka koi bhi point hai, is liye tangents ke jore ki combined equation:
\[9(x - 5)^{2} - 16y^{2} = 0\]
Kyun: yeh rishta dono tangents ke har point par sahi hai, is liye yahi un ki ikatthi equation hai.

Tasdeeq:
Factorise kijiye: \([3(x - 5) - 4y][3(x - 5) + 4y] = 0\), yani do lines \(y = \pm\frac{3}{4}(x - 5)\).
\(y = \frac{3}{4}(x - 5)\), yani \(3x - 4y - 15 = 0\), ka \((0, 0)\) se faasla \(\frac{15}{5} = 3\) hai, jo radius hai. Doosri line ka bhi yahi. Dono \((5, 0)\) se guzarti hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 13 ko Example 14 wale tareeqe se hal kijiye: \((5, 0)\) se slope \(m\) wali line \(y = m(x - 5)\), aur \(\frac{|-5m|}{\sqrt{m^{2} + 1}} = 3\). Kya \(m = \pm\frac{3}{4}\) aaya? Dono lines ko zarb dene se wahi combined equation \(9(x - 5)^{2} - 16y^{2} = 0\) ban jati hai.

Teesri misaal sab se mukammal hai: tangents bhi nikalne hain aur un ke points of contact bhi. Circle ka centre origin par nahin, is liye \(y = mx \pm a\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}\) wala formula yahan nahin chalega. Hum bunyadi baat istemal karenge: tangent woh line hai jis ka centre se faasla radius ke barabar ho. Yeh tareeqa har circle par kaam karta hai, is liye ise achhi tarah pakka kar lijiye.

blocks.title: Example 14
blocks.problem: Find the equations of the pair of tangents drawn from \((4, -1)\) to the circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 2x + 4y = 0\). Also find the points of contact.
steps:
Diya gaya: circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 2x + 4y = 0\) ...(1) aur point \((4, -1)\).
Maloom karna: \((4, -1)\) se dono tangents ki equations aur un ke points of contact.
Tareeqa: \((4, -1)\) se ek line likhenge jis ka slope \(m\) abhi na-maloom hai. Phir shart lagayenge ke centre se us ka faasla radius ke barabar ho; is se \(m\) ki do values niklengi. Aakhir mein har tangent ko circle ke saath hal kar ke us ka point of contact nikalenge.

Qadam 1: Centre aur radius
Yahan \(2g = -2\), \(2f = 4\), \(c = 0\). Circle ka centre \((1, -2)\) aur radius
\[\sqrt{(-1)^{2} + (2)^{2}} = \sqrt{5}\]
Kyun: centre \((-g, -f)\) aur radius \(\sqrt{g^{2} + f^{2} - c}\); \(g = -1\), \(f = 2\).

Qadam 2: \((4, -1)\) se slope \(m\) wali line
\[y + 1 = m(x - 4)\]
\[\Rightarrow mx - y - 4m - 1 = 0\]
Kyun: point-slope form; general form mein likha taa ke distance formula lag sake.

Qadam 3: Centre se faasla = radius
\[\dfrac{|m(1) - (-2) - 4m - 1|}{\sqrt{m^{2} + (-1)^{2}}} = \sqrt{5}\]
\[\Rightarrow \dfrac{|m + 2 - 4m - 1|}{\sqrt{m^{2} + 1}} = \sqrt{5}\]
\[\Rightarrow \dfrac{|-3m + 1|}{\sqrt{m^{2} + 1}} = \sqrt{5}\]
Kyun: line tangent tabhi hai jab centre se us ka faasla radius ke barabar ho. Centre ke coordinates \(x = 1\), \(y = -2\) line ke left side mein rakhe.

Qadam 4: Square kar ke \(m\) nikalna
\[(3m - 1)^{2} = 5(m^{2} + 1)\]
\[\Rightarrow 9m^{2} - 6m + 1 = 5m^{2} + 5\]
\[\Rightarrow 4m^{2} - 6m - 4 = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow 2m^{2} - 3m - 2 = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow 2m^{2} - 4m + m - 2 = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow 2m(m - 2) + 1(m - 2) = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow (m - 2)(2m + 1) = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow m = 2, \quad m = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: \(|-3m + 1|^{2} = (3m - 1)^{2}\); phir 2 se taqseem kiya aur middle term ko \(-4m + m\) mein tod kar factorise kiya. Do slopes aaye, kyun ke bahar ke point se do tangents hote hain.

Qadam 5: Tangents ki equations
Slopes ko line ki equation mein rakhne se tangents milte hain:
\(m = 2\) ke liye: \(2x - y - 8 - 1 = 0\)
\[\Rightarrow 2x - y - 9 = 0 \quad \text{...(2)}\]
\(m = -\frac{1}{2}\) ke liye:
\[-\dfrac{1}{2}x - y - 4\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right) - 1 = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow -\dfrac{1}{2}x - y + 1 = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow x + 2y - 2 = 0 \quad \text{...(3)}\]
Kyun: doosri line ko \(-2\) se zarb diya taa ke fraction khatam ho aur \(x\) ka coefficient positive ho.

Qadam 6: Pehla point of contact
(2) se \(y = 2x - 9\), is ko (1) mein rakhte hain:
\[x^{2} + (2x - 9)^{2} - 2x + 4(2x - 9) = 0\]
\[x^{2} + 4x^{2} - 36x + 81 - 2x + 8x - 36 = 0\]
\[5x^{2} - 30x + 45 = 0\]
\[x^{2} - 6x + 9 = 0\]
\[(x - 3)^{2} = 0 \Rightarrow x = 3\]
\(x = 3\) ko \(y = 2x - 9\) mein rakhne se \(y = 2(3) - 9 = -3\). Is liye ek point of contact \((3, -3)\) hai.
Kyun: tangent circle ko ek hi point par milta hai, is liye quadratic perfect square bana aur ek dohra root aaya. Yeh khud is baat ki tasdeeq hai ke (2) waqai tangent hai.

Qadam 7: Doosra point of contact
(3) se \(y = \frac{2 - x}{2}\), is ko (1) mein rakhte hain:
\[x^{2} + \left(\dfrac{2 - x}{2}\right)^{2} - 2x + 4\left(\dfrac{2 - x}{2}\right) = 0\]
\[x^{2} + \dfrac{4 - 4x + x^{2}}{4} - 2x + 4 - 2x = 0\]
\[x^{2} + \dfrac{x^{2} - 4x + 4}{4} - 4x + 4 = 0\]
4 se zarb dein (kitab yeh line do dafa chhaapti hai):
\[4x^{2} + x^{2} - 4x + 4 - 16x + 16 = 0\]
\[5x^{2} - 20x + 20 = 0\]
\[x^{2} - 4x + 4 = 0\]
\[(x - 2)^{2} = 0 \Rightarrow x = 2\]
\(x = 2\) ko \(y = \frac{2 - x}{2}\) mein rakhne se \(y = \frac{2 - 2}{2} = 0\). Is liye doosra point of contact \((2, 0)\) hai.
Kyun: wahi tareeqa; phir se perfect square aur ek dohra root.

Tasdeeq:
\((3, -3)\) circle par: \(9 + 9 - 6 - 12 = 0\); line (2) par: \(6 + 3 - 9 = 0\).
\((2, 0)\) circle par: \(4 + 0 - 4 + 0 = 0\); line (3) par: \(2 + 0 - 2 = 0\).
Dono tangents \((4, -1)\) se guzarte hain: \(8 + 1 - 9 = 0\) aur \(4 - 2 - 2 = 0\). Slopes 2 aur \(-\frac{1}{2}\) ka product \(-1\) hai, yani yahan dono tangents aapas mein perpendicular bhi hain.
blocks.answer: Tangents: \(2x - y - 9 = 0\) aur \(x + 2y - 2 = 0\); points of contact \((3, -3)\) aur \((2, 0)\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Example 14 mein do baatein khaas taur par note kijiye:
1. Points of contact nikalte waqt dono dafa quadratic perfect square bana. Agar aap ke sawal mein aisa na ho (do alag roots aayein), to samajh lijiye ke tangent ki equation mein kahin ghalti hai. Yeh ek muft tasdeeq hai.
2. Point of contact ek aur tareeqe se bhi nikal sakta hai: centre se tangent par perpendicular ka foot (paon). Normal hamesha centre se guzarta hai, is liye centre se tangent par seedhi line giraiye; jahan woh tangent se mile wahi point of contact hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Bahar ke point se do real tangents; circle par ek; andar koi nahin (Theorem 2).
2. \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) se \(x^{2} + y^{2} = a^{2}\) par chord of contact: \(xx_{1} + yy_{1} = a^{2}\) (shakal tangent jaisi, magar point bahar hai).
3. Kisi point se tangents: slope \(m\) lo, centre se faasla = radius rakho, \(m\) nikalo.
4. Points of contact: har tangent ko circle ke saath hal karo; sahi tangent hamesha dohra root deta hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(4x + 5y = 29\) ko tangent keh dena: yeh chord of contact hai, kyun ke \((4, 5)\) circle par nahin.
2. Jab \(m\) ki quadratic se sirf ek value aaye to vertical tangent bhool jana.
3. \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 2x + 4y = 0\) ka centre \((-1, 2)\) likh dena; sahi \((1, -2)\) hai.
4. Modulus \(|\ldots|\) ke saath sirf positive case hal karna; dono sides ka square kijiye taa ke dono signs shamil hon.
